valentine.title: Valentine: ChEMBL, TPC-DI, OpenData, Magellan, Wikidata
valentine.acquisition: Download the fixed v1 archive, about 602 MB; prepare audits mappings and requires explicit --skip-invalid for invalid release cases.

valentine-layout.title: Any existing Valentine-layout release or generated corpus
valentine-layout.acquisition: Supply --input containing Valentine-datasets/<family>/.../*_mapping.json and matching CSV files.

gdc.title: Existing Magneto GDC CSV release
gdc.acquisition: Supply --input containing gdc/{source-tables,target-tables,ground-truth}; for original supplementary XLSX inputs use gdcsm instead.

t2dsm.title: WDC T2D-SM with headers
t2dsm.acquisition: Fixed WH release; retains original train/valid/test in conversion manifest.

hdxsm.title: HDXSM 0.2
hdxsm.acquisition: Google Drive may require a browser; alternatively unpack the same archive and supply --input.

gdcsm.title: Magneto GDC-SM from original supplementary XLSX sheets
gdcsm.acquisition: Fetches mappings, target catalogue, and the ten original study supplements; publisher downloads may require manual acquisition.

mimic.title: MIMIC-IV demo 2.2 to OMOP demo 0.9
mimic.acquisition: Uses public demo releases only, with the 49-row Parciak mapping; no credentialed full MIMIC download.

madi.title: MaDI-Bench five base tasks (18 pairwise scenarios)
madi.acquisition: Obtain the repository at commit 655faa751536b0c33150f681adc1a305c570a114, then --input the checkout root. Download is manual; source terms apply.

goby.title: GOBY seeded sample of 200 eligible wrapper pairs
goby.acquisition: Download GOBY.zip from the official page (about 1.53 GB), password GOBY2025. Unpack it and goby_data_csv_files.tar.gz into wrappers/. Supply --input with wrappers/, both mapping CSVs and the inner tar.gz.

synthea.title: Synthea to OMOP (OMAP truth)
synthea.acquisition: Acquire omop_synthea_data.xlsx, Synthea CSV sample, and OHDSI Eunomia GiBleed_5.3. Layout and historical hashes are in docs/datasets.md.

controlled.title: Controlled MusicBrainz and Lahman (16 scenarios)
controlled.acquisition: Supply --input with Musicbrainz/medium, release, release_group headerless TSV dumps and Lahman/Batting.csv, People.csv, Teams.csv; see docs/datasets.md.

scale.title: Deterministic synthetic scaling corpus (93 scenarios)
scale.acquisition: Generated locally; no external data. --smoke creates one small case.

amalgam.title: Amalgam bibliographic schemas
amalgam.acquisition: Obtain original instances and a separately versioned correspondence set. Published schema pages do not supply separately curated correspondence annotations.

efes.title: EFES bibliography/music integration scenarios
efes.acquisition: Download Integration scenarios; retain published mappings. Match local schema/table names explicitly before converting. Separately curated annotations must be supplied explicitly if those are the intended ground truth.

musicbrainz.title: MusicBrainz raw database dump
musicbrainz.acquisition: Download a dated dump. Controlled adapter handles the three required tables; other generated variants need explicit generation recipes.

lahman.title: Lahman baseball database
lahman.acquisition: Download CSV release, retain release date and SHA256; controlled adapter accepts the three required tables.

adventureworks.title: AdventureWorks sample database
adventureworks.acquisition: Acquire pinned release and export CSV with declared order/delimiter/null policy. Pin the exported CSV snapshot; newer releases are not byte-identical.

imdb.title: IMDb non-commercial datasets
imdb.acquisition: Acquire a dated TSV snapshot under IMDb terms. Select basics, name, principals and any other declared tables explicitly; a moving latest snapshot is not a reproducible input.

sakila.title: MySQL Sakila sample database
sakila.acquisition: Obtain the sample database and export tables to CSV. Preserve keys, null policy and table names.

scope.title: SCOPe structural classification database
scope.acquisition: Obtain the recorded relational CSV snapshot (node/comment/level). Current public flat files are not drop-in CSV replacements.

tpch.title: TPC-H dbgen
tpch.acquisition: Use the recorded dbgen version/scale/seed and export CSV; record generated input hashes.

chinook.title: Chinook v1.4.5
chinook.acquisition: Get Chinook_Sqlite.sqlite from this release; use the independent-sampling recipe for normalized/denormalized matching scenarios.
